purpose: appearance adapter on frozen SportsReID; passes only if the gain on unseen teams is real and seen teams gain no more

split.A_note: train/ videos only; Dresden-Melsungen and Vinnhorst-Potsdam were the smart re-ID reserve, released for training by the user 2026-10-22
split.B_use: pilot run and gate recalibration only; never decides a pass bar

excluded.BalingenII-Erlangen: second team of Balingen (A): shared players possible; default exclusion
excluded.e.mp4 (train/): ASV Hamm against a white-blue team, possibly Muenster (D): overlap not ruled out
excluded.Melsungen-Berlin, BHC-FrischAuf: not processed for smart re-ID; would only add to C

split.windows: A, B: the mined smart re-ID window(s) per match; C, D: every mined window of the match (main and extra)
split.time_blocks: A windows: frames in the first 2/3 of each window are training, the last 1/3 is the seen same-match block (never trained)

model.adapter: residual low-rank: y = l2n(x + U V^T x), rank 16, U initialised to 0
model.augment: original; horizontal mirror; random crop jitter 8% + brightness/contrast/saturation jitter 0.15, seeded

training.loss: supervised contrastive within one match (temperature 0.1); positives = same match identity, other fragment, >= 50 frames apart; negatives = teammates (weight 1.0) and opponents (weight 0.3)
training.pilot: one run evaluated only on B and A's time blocks; changes after it only for defects, recorded; C and D untouched before the frozen run

benchmark.protocol: split_v2 benchmark: queries = vouched fragments, gallery both_notrack, query crops spread8, top-3 mean per crop, mean over 8, halves guard, min_sep 50 frames; unknowns natural + synthetic (own identity removed)
benchmark.conditions: base = frozen SportsReID on strict crops; adapter = same crops through the adapter; identical rows
benchmark.M: max coverage of known queries over the two-gate grid (score floor x margin) subject to known precision >= 0.95 and unknown false-match rate <= 0.03, on the pooled rows of a group
benchmark.ci: 95% bootstrap clustered by team, recomputing both gates per replicate, 2000 replicates, seed 0

pass.P2: G <= max(0.01, 0.25 * delta(unseen)) and the upper 95% bound of G <= 0.04
pass.P3: unknown false-match rate on D at the adapter's M operating point <= base rate at base's M operating point + 0.01

variants.b: mean of raw score and adapted strict score

system_check_if_pass.gate: recalibrated on B with the split_v2 calibration procedure
system_check_if_pass.evaluation: Stage 2 populations of D against existing references; newly named unreferenced segments -> blind assistant queue with controls, frozen before scoring
system_check_if_pass.lock_bar: newly correct player-time on D >= +25% relative to split_v2, added-link precision >= 0.95, synthetic unknown false-match rate <= 3%
